name: sweatstack-cloudflare-template
description: A starter app for SweatStack on Cloudflare Workers: Sign in with SweatStack, training data, PWA and push notifications.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SWEATSTACK_CLIENT_ID.description: Your SweatStack app's **Client ID**. Create an app at [app.sweatstack.no/applications/new](https://app.sweatstack.no/applications/new) and copy it from the OAuth tab. You can also leave this empty and follow the steps the app shows you.

SWEATSTACK_CLIENT_SECRET.description: A **client secret** from your SweatStack app's OAuth tab (Client secrets → Create). It is shown only once.

ADMIN_USER_IDS.description: Optional. Your SweatStack user id, for the Admin page. Leave empty: the app shows your id on Settings after you sign in.

SWEATSTACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional, for push notifications. Leave empty for now: the app's Admin page explains how to set up webhooks.

DB.description: Stores signed-in users (with encrypted tokens), push subscriptions and the webhook log. Created for you.
